title: 11 Best Herbal Teas For Gallstones
description: Cynara scolymus teas, also known as artichoke teas, have been used for centuries as a natural remedy to help treat gallstones and promote liver health. The bioactive constituents of Cynara scolymus, such as cynarin and silymarin, have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that help to reduce gallstone formation and improve liver function.
